text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.14 for the Senior Full Stack Software Developer position. The strongest evidence of their technical background is that they "Built REST APIs" and have listed experience with SQL and Git. However, the application has significant gaps, including missing requirements for nodejs, ruby, reactjs, docker, ci/cd, and cloud computing, as well as insufficient years of experience. Despite the low fit and missing must-have skills, this profile has been escalated for further review.
